verdict.rationale: Highnote documents that its in-house compliance and operations teams handle KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, reconciliation, settlement, and disputes, which covers much of the program-management burden. It also cites direct network integration and markets fast card-program launches, with a production-like test environment you can use before talking to anyone. However, the evidence never mentions BIN sponsorship or a sponsor bank, and gives no documented signup-to-first-live-card timeline. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/sponsor-bank arrangement, explicit network membership handled by the platform, documented time from signup to first live card, independent corroboration
